AC EVIDENCE, verified against merged main (Gerrit 2094, commit a8296be3b3). Each criterion run on its own stated command.

AC1 ineligible prior items yield nothing: 2 passed. AC2 per-state rules incl. the unresolvable-region default, and carry is one-shot (an already-carried item classifies withdrawn): 3 passed. AC3 a still-present item absent from fresh Pass-1 is injected carrying standing.state + standing.origin_revision: 2 passed. AC4 standing.origin_decision taken from the prior surfaced bucket, defaulting to advisory: 1 passed. AC5 carry-forward never raises a posture, including over a blocking_enabled criterion past its block_threshold: 2 passed.
AC6 the reader exposes revision and the per-item origin bucket: 3 passed in test_code_review_artifact.py.
AC7 dispatcher threads carried items in finder-blind and convergence is not regressed: 22 passed across test_code_review_gate_session.py and test_code_review_region_gate.py.
AC9 Gerrit marks carried findings and the prompt names them: the reviewer prompt matches 'standing finding|carried from an earlier patchset' once, finding_publish.py carries 'since patchset' twice, and test_review_bot.py is 90 passed / 14 skipped.
AC10 repo gates: make lint clean, complexity ratchet active=44 new=0 increased=0.

AC8 the shared kernel is untouched beyond a docstring - verified precisely rather than loosely. Scoped to THIS change's own commit (not a multi-commit span, which would have conflated other stories' edits), the entire delta to src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify.py is a docstring rewrap: the sentence 'the ONLY place the prior findings appear' is dropped and 'matched_prior_id' moves onto its own line. No executable line changed. test_review_kernel.py: 38 passed.
